messages:
marie: Quick design huddle re: the metric mosaic (4x4) in Console Insights. At narrow widths the y-axis text plus unit pills push the sparkline down and rows look uneven. Proposed ideas: tokenized unit pills (tiny rounded chips), a left compressed axis that toggles to full text on focus, or force single-line with ellipsis + a persistent legend. Also: smoothing control (client median vs exponential) and how we show spikes/anomalies when users want to inspect extremes. Thoughts?

cam: Token pills are clean visually. e.g., show `p95` and a tiny `ms` chip next to it. Click/tap the pill to open a small popover with full metric name and last value. Avoid hover-only interactions.

marie: Good. How should the DOM look for accessibility? We need SR users to get the full expansion without hunting for the popover.

toni: Include a visually-hidden full-label element inside the pill: "95th percentile latency (p95) in milliseconds". Make the pill focusable and set aria-expanded when the popover is open. For the compressed axis toggler, use a button with aria-pressed and aria-controls to reveal the full label element. Also ensure tab order keeps legend before the chart so SR users can discover it.

cam: Smoothing: median-of-5 is robust and cheap client-side; exponential smoothing is nicer for long tails but can blur narrow spikes. Maybe default to median-of-5 for tiles and add a global setting to switch kernel. Microcopy: label the toggle `Smoothing (reduce jitter)` with tooltip `Median smoothing preserves short spikes better than averaging.`

dana: On anomalies: dimming makes users think data is gone. Instead, use a hollow diamond marker for flagged points and a small badge cluster (e.g., `+4`) when markers overlap. Clicking the cluster expands a mini-list anchored to the point. Also provide an export link `Export anomalies (CSV)` in that mini-list.

marie: I like the cluster badge. How should the legend indicate the marker?

toni: Legend entry: a small diamond glyph then the copy `outlier — deviates from historical baseline`. Keep it one line. For screen readers add aria-describedby to each marker with a short summary like: "Outlier on 2026-02-10 03:00: 12.3 ms, roughly 3x baseline". Also consider announcing new anomaly markers via aria-live if they appear during a streaming view.

cam: Implementation note: computing median-of-5 per tile on the client is cheap; cluster detection might be a small spatial pass. We should avoid server-side kernel work for performance. Also keep the smoothing deterministic so cached results stable between renders.

dana: UX copy suggestions: Smoothing tooltip: `Smoothing (reduce jitter). Median-of-5 preserves sharp spikes.` Anomaly toggle label: `Show anomaly markers` and mini-list heading: `Top anomalies`.

marie: Action items: (1) I'll mock token-pills + compressed-axis states and the cluster badge UI; (2) cam to confirm median window and perf constraints; (3) toni to draft exact SR strings including aria-live examples. I'll post mocks and SR text in ~90 minutes.

preview-bot: Preview link: https://staging.redwood.ai/proto/mosaic-pills-clusters (expires in 24h)

marie: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll include code-friendly aria snippets when I post the mocks.
